name: Kiso's Pet Food Pantry (Brooklyn)
notes: A pet food pantry for Brooklyn's seniors and their pets, run with the food pantry at Good Shepherd Lutheran Church, so that nobody has to choose between feeding themselves and feeding their pet. Ring or email to ask when and where the next distribution is.
